description: Land Acquisition - The Land Compensations of Palliyawatta, Welibisse Mukalana, Nayewaththa, Ambalanwatta, Rangayearawa etc., Imbulpe D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices about compensation deposits for specific parcels of land acquired by the state, including detailed descriptions of land plots (names, plan numbers, lot numbers, extents, and compensation amounts). The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land acquisitions, property transfers to the state, and compensation matters related to real estate.
